objective: What electric two-wheeler products has Ather Energy announced recently in India?

result.executive_summary: Ather Energy announced the Konarc electric scooter in late August 2026, targeting the mass‑market segment in India.
result.industry_overview: Ather Energy continues to expand its electric two‑wheeler portfolio, adding a lower‑priced model to complement its premium Rizta and 450 lines.
market_trends: Growing demand for affordable electric scooters in India
company_developments: Introduced the Konarc model with six variants and pricing starting at Rs 99,999
product_launches: Konarc electric scooter – announced Aug 29 2026; bookings to begin mid‑September 2026
